sentences.en: The Council slaves whipped him with their hippopotamus hide whips.
sentences.zh: 议会奴隶用他们犀牛皮做的鞭子抽打他。

sentences.en: Even the stadium's PA announcer couldn't whip up the atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 就连体育场的公共广播员也无法激起现场气氛。

sentences.en: The Russian people groaned under the whip of the czars.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯人民在沙皇的统治下呻吟着。

senses.zh: 抽打；煽动；搅打（蛋，奶油）；[口]彻底击败 -
